means: for every corpus round whose bag 1 is shiwehi.com's はちみつ砲 bag 1 cell for cell (as drawn or mirrored), the deepest node of that page's route tree the round reaches, and how often each node's sampling point was reached
not_eligible_because: every board is the vendored Triangle engine's; which bag-2 and bag-3 shape was built has no second implementation. The Perfect Clear COUNT is anchored by perfect_clear_timing, the shape is not.
caveat: bag-1 opportunities count rounds that reached the sampling point clean (inside the verified prefix, no clear, no garbage before it); bag-2 and snapshot opportunities allow garbage: complete garbage rows are stripped from the bottom of the board first (garbage_rows_stripped), so they count rounds inside the verified prefix with no line cleared by the player before the sample. Bag-3 nodes have no separate sampling point and count the rounds that reached their parent. A hold is asserted only by the lock-7 piece test. The compromise form's order condition is the page's example (など), recorded as condition_met and never the reason a form was built. bag2_near is measured against the board before the TST, never a match.

rules.bag2_garbage: strip complete garbage rows from the bottom
rules.precedence: j_right (7 locks); only if it misses, j_hold (6 locks) split by the lock-7 piece against the mirror-aware bag-1 J
rules.condition_handedness: a mirrored round's bag-2 order is read with J<->L and S<->Z swapped
rules.group_scope: the five 2.ideal forms share one PC list: bag-3 patterns are scoped by the form's group
rules.bag2_near: a bag-1 round with no bag-2 match: the board before its TST, by occupancy, against every bag-2 board: a strict subset (the TST before the board was complete), that board plus exactly four cells, or that board with one piece's four cells moved elsewhere
